people.name: Rachel
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of Joseph and Benjamin

translations.web: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father’s sheep, for she kept them.
translations.bsb: While he was still speaking with them, Rachel arrived with her father’s sheep, for she was a shepherdess.
translations.kjv: And while he yet spake with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep: for she kept them.
translations.asv: While he was yet speaking with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep. For she kept them.
